first_missing_criterion: The official HM Land Registry INSPIRE download window exposes monthly GML Polygon geometry for registered freehold property, with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID per polygon. This materially changes the parser/spatial route from identifier-only lookup tables to authoritative polygon geometry. However the project's canonical_parcel_id inventory and canonical parcel Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry are not exposed in this public window, so a deterministic local spatial join from canonical_parcel_id to an INSPIRE polygon cannot be performed; consequently no canonical parcel can be classified or assigned a proven building type.
next_method_requirement: use a new official public no-login source/window exposing project canonical_parcel_id Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry or an exact canonical_parcel_id binding; spatially bind it to official INSPIRE/other authoritative geometry, then require a real building footprint and proven building type before acceptance
